svg.title: Measured pre-boot packed MFD HSIZE contrast
svg.desc: Four fresh HSIZE4 probes yielded eight sequential source-matching Y/C observations each, with PICTURE_SYNC LAST_PIXEL at ordinal 7. HSIZE8 END1 references yielded sixteen observations and LAST_PIXEL at ordinal 15. The raw source-field cycles contain four versus eight values, each repeated twice. These are not accepted-transfer, source-lease or completion certificates.
svg.metadata: BCM70015; HSIZE4 A/B/A′/B′ on 2026-10-05 at 12:59:21/13:01:43/13:04:47/13:06:28 KST. HSIZE8 END1 reference: #230. A source DWORDs aa425531 bb646653 cc867775 dda88897; B source DWORDs 55bdaace 449b99ac 3379888a 22577768. Five MPEG-2 controls: 180 frames, 20736000 bytes each, SHA256 7278bf6c89d602a34e4a8cf8261da45c0889bb0645fdb1fcb13810378f8fcb32. One H.264 control: 180 frames, 82944000 bytes, SHA256 3aace3af0e846833059e2f07739e558ce64cb68dac9baf07ef5569f905e714e1.

g.text: Packed MFD: HSIZE4 versus HSIZE8 raw profiles
BCM70015 · isolated pre-boot experiment · signed payload staged but never booted · four fresh probes: A, B, A′, B′
Only MFD setup contrast from #230: HSIZE literal 8 → 4. END remains 1; no accepted-output or completion inference.
HSIZE4 guards pin empirical raw pairs (0x780,0x436) → (4,0x436) → (4,1); reset-default and field-unit semantics remain unproved.
Same 96-byte prefix: 16 reference bytes + 80 padding bytes, NOT a fetch bound. LINE0=0, STRIDE0, CTRL5 remain unchanged.
A / A′
B / B′
solid + dots: HSIZE4
dashed: HSIZE8 END1 reference (#230)
Y field (10-bit)
Observation ordinal / logged host pulse-pair attempts
Alternating chroma field (10-bit)
Observation ordinal / logged host pulse-pair attempts
HSIZE4: first four source Y/C octets ×4, repeated twice (32 observations total). HSIZE8: eight-value cycles, repeated twice.
PICTURE_SYNC labels agree in SAMPLE and TAP; repeated raw series match exactly (A′=A, B′=B)
HSIZE8
HSIZE4
0=normal, 1=FIRST_PIXEL, 2=LAST_PIXEL. HSIZE4 stops at ordinal 7; later ordinals are NOT READ.
HSIZE8 reference: 16 observations / 15 host pairs / 40 target attempts. HSIZE4: 8 / 7 / 24. These are NOT accepted counts.
Both profiles: READY1 / ACCEPT0, FEED.LINE_COUNT2, LAST_LINE0, feeder-error bits0; EOF was not observed.
EOL only at ordinal 8 (HSIZE8) or 4 (HSIZE4). All 28 HSIZE4 post-W9 readbacks were 8; pulse/latch semantics remain unproved.
Four fresh pre-CMAC aborts and stock cleanups succeeded; six separate full 180-frame, full-pixel and EOS native controls PASS.
Sequential observations are not atomic snapshots. Source namespace/units/extent/runtime lease, accepted output and completion remain unproved.
